slides.heading: Longest Palindromic Substring
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Strings
slides.narration: Let's solve Longest Palindromic Substring, a medium strings problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Expand around every centre (odd and even).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Expand around every centre (odd and even).

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Every palindrome has a centre; expand around each of the 2n minus 1 centres.
slides.narration: Every palindrome has a centre; expand around each of the 2n minus 1 centres.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: DP table → O(n²) time and space
Expand around 2n − 1 centres → O(n²) time, O(1) space
slides.narration: Checking every substring is cubic. A DP table is quadratic in time and space. Expanding around each of the two n minus one centres is quadratic time but constant space.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. For each index, expand odd and even centres
slides.narration: Step by step. First, for each index, expand odd and even centres. Second, track the longest span. Third, return the substring.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: For each i we expand from i,i and i,i plus one while the ends match, then compare the length r minus l minus one with the best and update.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n squared. Space is O of n output.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: Don't forget even-length palindromes, centred between letters.

slides.narration: Mention Manacher's algorithm for linear time.
